nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.qc.slice_review
====================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.qc.slice_review

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Embedded per-ROI review UI for QC slice viewers + report header toolbar.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.qc.slice_review.report_header_toolbar_html

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: report_header_toolbar_html(*, batch: str, subject: str, pipeline: str, report_relpath: str) -> str

   Top toolbar: Mark as revised + reviewer name (right side in header).


.. py:function:: report_footer_toolbar_html(*, batch: str, subject: str, pipeline: str, report_relpath: str) -> str

   Bottom toolbar: Mark as revised (reuses header reviewer via window.qcGetReviewer).


.. py:function:: embedded_review_panel_js(dom_id: str, review_ctx: dict) -> str

   JS for per-ROI dual-aspect status/comment panel inside a slice viewer.


.. py:function:: embedded_review_panel_html(dom_id: str) -> str

   Build the ROI review panel HTML (segmentation/measurement QC selects, comment box, status
   line) embedded next to the slice viewer identified by *dom_id*.


.. py:function:: review_context(*, batch: str, subject: str, pipeline: str, report_relpath: str, structures: Iterable[str]) -> dict

   Build the review-context payload (batch/subject/pipeline, reviewable structures, aspects and
   their labels) used to render the embedded review UI for a QC report.
